reference_point.label: Paper operating point
reference_point.note: The paper reports 1 W typical incoming power at 300 GHz red detuning; its exact measurement plane and full ramp are not tabulated.

Cs-133.initial_temperature_basis: Engineering comparison assumption; a Cs L1 initial temperature has not been measured in this project.

reference_point.label: Cs 600 GHz / 500 uK design
reference_point.note: Source power is solved from the 500 uK handover-depth target using the configured 70% delivery efficiency.

l2_transport.duration_note: Trapezoid v_max reproduces the paper's 17 cm / 21 ms L2 stage; waist interpolates from the L1-calculated handover radius to end_waist_um. Paper values are approximate; v_max is derived from distance, duration and acceleration.

conveyor_geometry.note: Optional offset-waist conveyor geometry (reports/offset_waist双束conveyor几何理论框架.md). Disabled by default; when enabled the two beam waists sit at (L-s)/2 and (L+s)/2 with constant per-branch source power. 19.5 cm = L1 distance/2, i.e. waists at the 1/4 and 3/4 points.

transport_monte_carlo.note: Optional trajectory-level Monte Carlo for the L1/L2 transport legs (reports/运输蒙特卡洛与双束底层光场理论框架.md). Disabled by default; when enabled simulate_l1_transport branches to transport_mc.simulate_leg_monte_carlo and the L2 leg inherits via replace. particle_count, seed, include_scattering and cloud_axial_sigma_mm are shared with the handover_monte_carlo group; tens of seconds per grid point at N=1000 for L1.

handover_monte_carlo.backend_note: compute_backend: cpu (NumPy, default) or gpu (CuPy/CUDA; inner trajectory loops run on GPU, outer scan should use serial backend)

adaptive_refinement.note: Two-stage adaptive particle allocation for the handover Monte Carlo grid: first pass uses particle_count trajectories per point; points whose transfer-efficiency Jeffreys standard error exceeds target_standard_error are re-run with particle_count*(SE/target)^2 trajectories (same L1 final state, same seed), capped by max_particle_count. Disabled by default; applies to l1-handover-scan / full-chain-scan / handover-map on both CPU and GPU backends.
